verdict.rationale: Brex documents real-time coding of spend: AI agents categorize spend instantly against policy, AI assistants write memos and fetch receipts, and uploaded receipts are matched to expenses automatically. It also positions this as enabling real-time close, with prepared expense data syncing to accounting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant-data capture and GL/accounting-field coding detail, in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
